map.同时可看各分量平方和: Also shows the sum of squared components
map.用于距离、归一化等计算: Used for distance, normalization and similar calculations
map.求向量长度/距离，归一化前先算模。: Find vector length/distance; compute the magnitude before normalizing.
map.计算两点距离或做向量归一化前的准备：先算出模长，再把向量除以它得到单位方向向量。: As a preparation for distance or normalization: first compute the magnitude, then divide the vector by it to get a unit direction vector.
map.点计算得到模长: Click calculate to get the magnitude
map.模长即各分量平方和的平方根: The magnitude is the square root of the sum of squared components
map.做归一化时，把每个分量除以该模长即得单位向量: To normalize, divide each component by the magnitude to get a unit vector
map.向量除以其模长得到单位长度。: Divide the vector by its magnitude to get unit length.
map.因为很多运算只关心方向不关心长度：光照计算中的法向量、相似度比较中的特征向量、梯: Because many operations care about direction, not length: normal vectors in lighting, feature vectors in similarity comparison and directions in gradient descent all need unit length, otherwise magnitudes distort the numbers and samples aren't comparable. Normalizing means dividing the vector by its own magnitude to get a same-direction vector of length 1.
